add_file_descriptor_proto: add a FileDescriptorProto to the descriptor database for later lookup by file name or symbol
find_file_by_name: find a file descriptor proto in the database by its proto file name
find_file_containing_symbol: find the file descriptor proto containing a fully qualified symbol like package.Message
extract_symbols_from_descriptor: extract all fully qualified symbol names from a descriptor proto including nested types and enums
handle_conflicting_definitions: detect and raise an error when adding a proto with the same name but different descriptor
